# Visual Smash

> Visual Smash is a Stockton, CA marketing agency, creative studio, and web development team, serving the Stockton, CA, Central Valley, and San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2004, we deliver custom web design, brand identity, UX design, AI-powered creative, marketing automation, SEO, and Microsoft Power Platform solutions for Fortune 500 companies and ambitious startups.
